name: Learn a few harmonica songs
blurb: Fits in a pocket, needs no tuning, and a diatonic harmonica in C is arranged so most wrong notes still sound acceptable. Three songs in a fortnight is realistic.
gear: A 10-hole diatonic harmonica in the key of C
steps: Learn to hold it and to get single clean notes — either by puckering or by tongue-blocking. This is the main beginner hurdle.
Learn the note layout of holes 4 to 7, where most simple melodies live.
Play a simple melody from tab, slowly, until each note speaks cleanly.
Learn to play with breath control rather than force; harmonicas reward gentle air.
Learn a basic chugging rhythm on the low holes for accompaniment.
Learn three songs to performance standard, then try bending a note on hole 4 draw.
tips: Two notes at once means your embouchure is too wide. Narrow the aperture and relax.
Playing hard wrecks the reeds and sounds worse. Breathe, do not blast.
Keep it dry and tap it out after playing.
proof: You play three recognisable tunes cleanly, single notes throughout.
